investor.label: Verdict
investor.note: Do not proceed at indicated basis

findings.title: 1998 Vermillion deal is administration, not ownership
findings.detail: Foundational agreement is an admin/co-publishing deal with reversion to writers on termination — whether Northbridge ever owned the catalog is unresolved. No renewal notices or estoppels on file.
findings.action: Estoppel certificates from writers/estates; title opinion from Reeves & Patel

findings.title: 2017 assignment deed unexecuted; schedules missing
findings.detail: Blank signature blocks; master purchase agreement and all schedules/annexes referenced but absent. Deed recites 40 compositions vs 32 being sold vs 60 in seller's internal inventory.
findings.action: Request executed deed + complete schedules (P0, seller)

findings.title: Masters chain undocumented
findings.detail: Northbridge's interest in Pale Engines / Migrant Hour masters rests on a 2014 Reston Vance/Capston assignment not in the data room.
findings.action: Request 2014 masters assignment (P0)

findings.title: Revenue overstated ~60–74%
findings.detail: Claimed $820k/$785k vs $470–512k verifiable. Gap ≈ Capston label gross (~$306k/yr) counted as publishing income — Northbridge collects only ~18% royalty on it.
findings.action: Re-cut offer off verified base; request per-song ledger

findings.title: Future-dated distributor statement
findings.detail: Capston 2H-FY2026 covers Jan–Jun 2026, issue-dated 28 Oct 2026 — after today. Conveniently the highest gross since FY2022. Fabrication signal.
findings.action: Challenge seller; treat all Capston figures as unverified

findings.title: Settlement double-counted; phantom income booked
findings.detail: $42k BMW settlement booked in both 2022 and 2023 ('inconsistency is intentional' per internal note); $30k PRS black-box payout never received but booked as actual; $8k MFN catch-up unconfirmed.
findings.action: Request settlement memo + confirmations (P1, Pulse)

findings.title: Writer-share double-counting in summaries
findings.detail: PRS line in CY2023 overview is 2.46× the actual publisher entitlement; ASCAP +37%. Writer shares paid directly to writers are counted as Northbridge income.
findings.action: Rebuild revenue from statement-level publisher shares only

findings.title: Undisclosed $120k advance, silent recoupments
findings.detail: Capston 2019 marketing advance side letter absent; $5,800 recouped invisibly in 1H-FY2024; accounting export and PDF disagree by ~$4,928 while claiming to match.
findings.action: Request side letter + full recoupment ledger

findings.title: Concentration worse than disclosed
findings.detail: December Rooftops ≈ 39% of earnings (claimed ~30%); top 5 ≈ 65% (claimed 56%) — and rising. 54% of 2024 sync gross.
findings.action: Stress-test valuation on single-song dependency

findings.title: Quiet Engine: operative split sheet unsigned, writer lawyered up
findings.detail: Two conflicting versions; v2 (incl. Hassan Iqbal 12%) unsigned by 2 of 5 writers. Iqbal claims years of unpaid UK/US royalties; counsel engaged. PRS allocates him 12% he says he never receives.
findings.action: Ratify split sheet; quantify back-royalties; settle pre-closing

findings.title: Carrying Stones: 4% writer missing from PRS registration since 2005
findings.detail: Naomi Tate's signed 4% share absent from PRS registration; two written complaints (2022, 2023) ignored. ~20 years of back-payment liability.
findings.action: PRS re-registration + back-pay quantification

findings.title: December Rooftops: 30% writer share frozen in suspense
findings.detail: Lena Akhtar (30% writer on the catalog's top earner) died March 2022; PRS holds her share in suspense; no estate contact exists. Known internally, undisclosed to buyers.
findings.action: Locate estate; resolve suspense before closing

findings.title: Slow Engine: sample share signed 12 years post-mortem
findings.detail: 8% sample share (Curtis Hammond, d. 1989) 'signed' 14 Jun 2001. Controlling Bug Music side letter exists only as an illegible 2001 fax. Internal note: 'sample escalation 2027? check legal.'
findings.action: Obtain legible side letter from BMG incl. escalation terms

findings.title: Petrov estate: no probate, informal banking changes
findings.detail: Julian Petrov writes on all 32 songs (~25% average). Zero succession documents; estate bank details changed by post ('I never quite trust email'). Payment-redirection risk.
findings.action: Grant of probate + verified payment instructions (callback controls)

findings.title: Pulse issuing licences on an expired appointment
findings.detail: 3-year sync agency appointment (Jan 2018, unsigned copy) never renewed; Pulse still issued licences in 2021–22 incl. BMW commercial. Licence validity risk.
findings.action: Post-2021 authority docs + full licence schedule (P2)

findings.title: GEMA statements 2021–2023 lost entirely
findings.detail: Three years of German income unverifiable — internally admitted inbox-handover failure; Germany booked at $0 in CY2023 overview.
findings.action: GEMA reissues duplicates on request (P1)

findings.title: No MLC statements — entire society absent
findings.detail: HFA mechanicals stop 2019-Q4; US mechanical income 2021+ (The MLC era) entirely undocumented.
findings.action: Request MLC statements 2021–2025

findings.title: 20+ statements missing across 9 societies
findings.action: Bulk duplicate-statement requests to each society

findings.title: Misfiled and impossible files
findings.detail: BMI 2020-Q2 filed in ASCAP folder; Spotify 2019-05 in Amazon folder; SOCAN statement in APRA folder; Tidal '2025-13.csv' (13th month) is empty; Vermillion GBP statement in Capston folder.
findings.action: Refile per manifest; pipeline auto-detects on re-run

findings.title: 'FINAL' term sheet is byte-identical to the draft
findings.detail: Three term sheet filenames (v1_PRE_LOI, DRAFT, 'v3 post call FINAL') share one MD5 — no post-call changes were ever made. scan_final.pdf is a holiday photo renamed.
sources: indicative term sheet v3 (post call) FINAL.pdf
findings.action: Request the actual negotiated term sheet

findings.title: 13 zero-byte placeholders, 17 duplicate groups, 3 empty folders
findings.detail: 'AWAITING_UPLOAD' shells (SACEM 2025-H2, MCPS 2025-Q4), Office lock files, failed exports, corrupt PDFs ('2H-FY2025 (corrupt).pdf'), 35 junk/system files.
findings.action: Hygiene list auto-generated; reissue corrupt/empty files
